reliability of agentic AI grading of handwritten university exams | Claude Code (Opus 4.6) grading 60 papers with 3 rubric files: r=0.97, MAE 0.85 marks, ICC=0.96, 92.8% diagnostic feedback; recurring failure modes (keyword matching, selection-state ambiguity, attention drift); single-session education-domain application without a self-improvement loop — excluded

whether RLVR inherits or amplifies reward hacking under an imperfect verifier | exact full response-distribution analysis varying leak universality and verifier false-positive rate, tangent-kernel covariance decomposition; hack rate inherited exactly at KL optimum, parameter sharing amplifies widely-accepted leaks (higher at high universality under Adam/SGD/sampled GRPO); verifier patches targeting repeated mistakes differ by up to 38 pts true accuracy

no principled control loop for temporary weight-space interventions on a serving model | Neural Control Plane: telemetry, candidate rule synthesis, admission criteria, versioned policy table + W-ISA transactional parameter restoration; SmolLM-135M-Instruct experiment: one projection cuts validation repetition 0.4133->0.2191 at -0.0574% perplexity, admission gate archived all three candidates (zero new correct answers), fresh-process and resumption reproduction

uneven domain capabilities produced by multi-teacher on-policy distillation | domain-routed deltas (expert-initialized, per-domain optimizer states and clipping) on a frozen base + Post-separate per-domain export; 32.83% vs 32.21% Macro across six benchmarks after 20 updates vs matched shared control (AdamW); Open-MOPD weighting raises Macro further

lab automation requires pre-scripted procedures and fixed positions or fiducial markers | Curie's Jarvis on a Franka Panda arm reads printed protocol photos, finds unlabeled containers on a people-oriented bench via 4 camera views, re-localizes before each step; completes 5/5 and 4/5 protocol runs with no human intervention, 160/160 correct container identifications on printed and handwritten labels

decisions.anchor: silently alter what the model receives or emits
decisions.reason: fault origin, propagation and missed detection in long-horizon multi-agent systems (72% of failed runs contained unused contrary evidence; 31% flagged deviations never removed; 45% of hand-crafted Who&When failures ended with the harness emitting a final answer no agent produced after a provider content-filter crash) | trajectory-centered annotation protocol on 95 failed runs from Who&When and MAD corpora; judges/contracts/re-checking reach most episodes, own-state restoration suffices in 35/95

what drives emergence of symbolic mechanisms supporting abstract reasoning | from-scratch training on abstract sequence tasks varying architecture and data-distribution axes; representational, attentional and causal-mediation analyses; greater data diversity yields stronger symbolic signatures, same signatures in modified transformers and even MLPs; entity-attribute binding replication

compute allocation across pretraining/SFT/RL stages poorly understood | random-matrix theory + operator-projection closure of a linear-autoencoder pretrain + noisy-stepwise-label SFT + sparse-episodic-reward RL model; Bayes error ~ inverse sqrt of pretraining ratio, SFT warm start shortens RL plateau (also observed in OLMo-2 1B on GSM8K), non-monotonic optimal RL compute share; learning theory, no infra operator/scheduling/failure anchor

MRI research assistance requires connecting acquisition physics, data conventions, tools and validation | MRFoundry package with project-local memory + output checks, plus MRI Agent Bench; 240 paired Core evaluations (24 task types, 10 models): all-checks-passed 67.5%->78.3%, Hard pairs 36.6%->44.8%; domain toolkit without a self-improvement loop — excluded

decode-pool tension between KV-cache capacity and attention bandwidth (DP replicates weights, TP capped by KV heads, DCP adds cross-node aggregation) | Decode Token Parallelism places balanced layer blocks with per-request local attention; only current-token activations cross nodes, all-reduces stay within NVLink; vLLM implementation, Llama-3.1-405B and Nemotron-4-340B on up to 64 H100s, up to 1.7x over DCP and 2.06x over data parallelism

LoRA-adapter transmission bottlenecking distributed on-policy post-training over bandwidth-constrained networks | HiLo compressor-agnostic compressed-gradient dissemination + local optimizer replay keeping learner and workers at consistent policy versions, with Spar spectral-truncation + adaptive-rank + error-feedback budget-aware compressor; 1.6% of adapter bytes at near-full-sync quality, up to 2.2x faster updates on on-policy distillation and reward-guided post-training

temporal downsampling misaligning segment boundaries in temporal sentence grounding (not numerical precision) | ABRR model-agnostic post-processing: Gaussian score smoothing + 2-Wasserstein/Sinkhorn boundary refinement + quality-driven re-ranking; consistent gains at IoU=0.7 on Charades-STA, ActivityNet Captions, QVHighlights; video grounding method — 'quantization' here means temporal bins, not low-precision arithmetic

offline accuracy sweeps of Euler step counts may miss a separate local-stability requirement in flow-matching policies | exact two-coordinate system + controlled augmentation of six trained flow models separating accuracy from Euler non-expansion stability; frozen pi_0.5-LIBERO checkpoint over 30 inputs: strong contracting directions at the action endpoint but no sampled mode violates non-expansion; 5 inputs need 4-9 steps at 5% error vs 87-112 at 1% (accuracy-limited)

decisions.anchor: internal representations and hidden states of LLMs
decisions.reason: decoded-word heatmaps cannot show whether or how much the model uses residual-stream information | interactive viewer decoding every residual cell with logit lens + Jacobian lens, tracing token sources and editing with live rerun (Gemma-3-4B-it); layer-7 country swap redirects two-hop answers 92-98%; correct answer already top word before reasoning for 89-92% of retrieval questions; J-lens reads answers 1-2 layers earlier

whether LLM-agent-proposed functional forms survive self-consistency and external evaluation | frontier agents via Model Context Protocol to a GPU evaluator with training-only fitting and persistent memory; Opus-5.5 agents pass screening at ~40x fewer tokens than GPT-6-Astra Codex; O159 13-parameter functional lowers omegaB97M-V held-out MGCDB84 error by 11.7%, beats SyFES evolutionary search (~400 fits each)

decisions.anchor: the reliability and trustworthiness of long-running autonomous agent systems
decisions.reason: agent evaluations focus on capability, not how behaviors develop and influence outcomes over an agent's working life | epidemiologic cohort design treating agents as cohort members (model as genotype, accumulated work as time scale, behaviors as exposures) with causal preventable-burden estimation; two prospective observational cohorts (curiosity/probing as safety, data-checking/analytical accuracy as reliability)

unclear whether MRoPE cross-modal spatial effects help or hinder vision-language models | shared-layout constraint identification + controlled isolation of intra-visual vs cross-modal spatial effects across model scales, MRoPE variants and benchmarks; cross-modal effects give little benefit and can impair performance while intra-visual encoding aids grounding; positional-encoding design study, not hidden-state analysis

hand-written verifiers are expensive and do not scale, yet self-improving systems depend on verifier quality | Veritas harness with evidence headers, unstated-domain-rule library and self-improvement-refined authoring principles; with the model fixed, generated verifiers agree with certified official verdicts better than 7 other harnesses on all 4 execution-scored benchmarks (6 total) and beat the vendor harness on 2 of 3 other model families; improves 9/12 harness-benchmark pairs

silent and loud faults anywhere in an LLM training run wasting long runs ('the loss lies') | Plumbline correctness-validation system checking data, served model, new layers and whole runs, with reusable checks for root-cause tracing; production at Amazon across 3 frameworks and 5 models: 61 problems found (32 silent), 42 fixed or reported upstream (8 first raised by them), 7 recurring failure patterns

low-bit quantization degrading LLM-agent task success via overlooked task/environmental conditions and divergent environment transitions | SteerDistill closed-loop teacher steering: full-precision teacher guides revision of failed student responses using execution feedback, internalized by quantization-aware distillation; +1.67-2.18 pts over strongest quantized baseline under W4A16 across 5 agentic benchmarks / 3 models, within 1 pt of BF16, beats QeRL by 1.84 pts on tau2-Bench with 67% fewer GPU hours

metastable persistent degradation of prefix-cached agent serving after brief bursts (vLLM: ~10% hit ratio, about half throughput, backlog growing for 70 min while the no-burst twin stays healthy; 9/12 pairs) | first-order workload-balance condition; throttling recovered only 1/7 collapsed runs, capacity-based session suspension recovered all within minutes, KV-demand budgeter prevented the failure in every run; replicated with Qwen3-32B SWE-bench trace shapes and on SGLang

203 GB Engram n-gram lookup tables consuming 190 of 223 GiB host memory in DeepSeek-V4.1 serving | SlackTier table tier for SGLang: step-start lookups under per-layer prefetch deadlines with slowdown-prediction model, split GPU row cache, bit-exact gather inside the decode CUDA graph; both tables on 4 NVMe disks: <=1.4% mean time-per-output-token rise, host memory 212->34 GiB; RDMA serves both tables cacheless; freed memory as host KV cache: +36% median throughput, p90 TTFT 38->24 s

discarded parallel drafts stealing up to 40% of step time from other requests at high serving load | ForeSpark work-conserving speculation on vLLM: context-aware acceptance pre-estimator + global-sort joint draft-verify scheduler + post-draft verification budget distribution; up to 1.77x over DSpark and 2.49x over autoregressive decoding at matched generation rate without changing the output distribution, sustains 1.51x request rate under latency SLOs

sequential evaluation of nonlinear state space models limiting parallel hardware exploitation | parallel Broyden quasi-Newton with diagonal-plus-low-rank Jacobian blocks built from trajectory secants, rank-compressed parallel scan, finite-step exact recovery proof; fewer iterations than other quasi-Newton methods on low-rank RNNs, parallel MCMC and denoising diffusion; fastest when Jacobian evaluation is expensive or state dims large

recursive self-improvement gains may not justify the full token cost of the improvement process | RSI Tax end-to-end accounting over continual task streams across 6 methods and 2 LLMs: bounded-note baseline matches/exceeds Meta-Harness, EvoSkill and RRSI accuracy at 65.6-71.0% mean token savings; verification is 74.8-93.6% of the tax; unused states/artifacts tracked

catalyst-design knowledge dispersed across subdisciplines | CatAI modular physics-grounded encoders (1.8M structure-property relations, 30 encoders) with task-specific models; -7.8% task-averaged prediction error vs next-best; experimental validations incl. 9x-activity catalyst and Cu geminal-atom photocatalyst beating Ni systems; chemistry-domain ML framework, not self-evolving LLM agents

agent-benchmark saturation lying in pass/fail measurement rather than task difficulty | re-scoring released runs of 8 benchmarks (SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench, MLE-bench, ALE-Bench, SWE-fficiency, AlgoTune); neighbouring top-ten agents differ by less than SWE-bench test error, ALE-Bench top-10 tie under median-human grading; clipped log-ratio score with dated anchors separates pass/fail-tied models by over 10x on the discarded quantity

representation-motivated architectural modifications lacking noise-floor, geometric-null and matched-intervention validation | three reusable checks applied to self-attention removal across 9 pretrained models (5,408 heads, 124M-6.9B): earlier-position causal null explains 48-63% of head-value cosine alignment; pre-registered 3-arm x 8-seed factorial at 4.0e8 tokens/run: self-directed removal lowers validation loss (-0.0029 nats, Holm p=0.0023) while a fixed arbitrary direction does not (p=0.197)

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: BF16 round-to-nearest weight sticking slowing RLVR convergence vs FP16 at the same learning rate (small updates leave the BF16 rollout/training weights unchanged for several optimizer steps) | stochastic rounding of FP32 shadow weights to BF16 matches FP16 convergence speed across models and datasets with lower KL from the reference model than raising the BF16 learning rate, keeping BF16 dynamic range without loss scaling

massive activations concentrating up to 99.9% of activation variance on PC1, undermining SAE evaluations (47 of top-50 important features unmatched across runs; 99.96% variance explained while 33% of non-PC1 variance unexplained) | train SAE on PC1-removed activations and add PC1 back to the reconstruction: top-50 feature sharing rises from 4-39.5% to 73-99.5%, up to 44% less model degradation at same TopK, up to 33.9% lower content reconstruction error

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: unclear how SFT/DPO/RLVR change use of internal information vs verbalized chain-of-thought | carry-value probing on successive Olmo-3-7B-Instruct checkpoints during multi-digit addition: probes recover carry equally in SFT and RLVR (and manipulation does not control outputs), but RLVR-produced CoTs yield higher accuracy across receiving checkpoints and carry-related statements get higher importance scores after RLVR; DPO shows sensitivity without accuracy gains

decisions.anchor: training dynamics and failure modes of RL post-training
decisions.reason: dense process rewards apparently beating GRPO per-update but losing once their sampling compute is counted (Monte-Carlo continuations alone consume 91% of generated tokens) | matched-compute protocol with preregistered controls, 1,668 runs on 6 models: Qwen2.5-1.5B MC reward ends -14.3 pts at equal tokens and -7.8 at equal training time; none of 4 dense variants beats GRPO; near-1/2-success prompt selection gains +1.7/+0.8 pts, replicated on fresh seeds and unseen problems

manual cognitive modeling is expertise- and time-intensive; LLM generation sacrifices structural plausibility and identifiability | DisCo LLM-guided evolutionary search with structural Validator and parameter-identifiability Cleaner; three behavioral tasks, competitive with task-specific baselines; ablations show the Validator recovers psychologically meaningful structure and external-measure associations

decisions.anchor: corruption of model outputs caused by the numerics, kernels or serving stack underneath the model
decisions.reason: vendor deployment pipelines silently changing model accuracy and distorting edge-NPU rankings | three-configuration methodology (Baseline / Vendor-Guided NPU-only / Vendor-Guided End-to-End) on 4 edge NPUs x 3 vision workloads: VG-NPU improves accuracy and Runtime latency in 10/12 combos, VG-E2E improves accuracy in only 4 while cutting System latency everywhere; NPU-level rankings do not match End-to-End rankings; VG-E2E adds 10.4-70.7% further latency reduction

jailbreak attacks bypassing alignment safeguards | TERM target-free entropy-guided residual modulation calibrated to each prompt's prefill baseline with adaptive scale normalization and temporal accumulation; vs 7 defenses on 7 jailbreak attacks and 2 over-refusal benchmarks across Llama/Qwen/Gemma (0.6B-32B); model-side safety defense, explicitly out of scope (abstract describes TERM; title mentions block-sparse prefilling but no such content is evaluated)

BPE fragmenting Chinese text (3.84 bytes/token, 64% single-character tokens) and hiding spelling from the model | vocabulary shrunk 248,320->384 on Qwen3.8-27B with two-stage curriculum on 4.77 GB of self-generated supervised bytes (178.6 h on 8xH200); within paired CI on MATH-500/HumanEval+/MMLU-Pro/non-thinking GSM8K, -4-6 pts on C-Eval and thinking tasks, character-task gains (CUTE 75.2->84.0), 3-5x less output per step; tokenizer-conversion study, not an official frontier-model system card

cumulative textbook formalization in low-resource proof libraries (concept-declaration alignment, live proof-state synchronization, reliable integration into a growing codebase) | Megrez Rocq formalization agent over MK set theory: source-rebuildable knowledge graph with multi-lane retrieval, feedback-driven 1-5 tactic short-burst loop with goal-local branch ledger and structured reflection, three-check acceptance (statement fidelity, axiom auditing, full builds); deployed on a point-set topology corpus

experience-reuse systems like Sentry paying large-model generative diagnosis cost before retrieving advice | Synapse-Control lightweight runtime control plane: rule shortlisting + 1.7B classifier on teacher-labeled state-suggestion pairs + micro-contracts + Prompt Value Table with cooldowns/token budgets; 1,308 attempts per method on AppWorld/WebShop: 270 successes (+29.8% vs Base), replaces 4,987 generative diagnosis calls, -50.2%/-51.0% auxiliary control time vs Sentry
